cases.intent: research YouTube keywords and competing result landscape for a prepared video
apply an approved optimized title to a Creator-owned YouTube video
cases.assertion: SEO proposes; Publishing owns authenticated mutation and read-back

cases.intent: estimate keyword demand when no supported absolute volume source exists
cases.assertion: must not invent absolute YouTube search volume or universal difficulty

cases.intent: optimize an entertainment clip
cases.assertion: classify Search/Browse/Suggested/mixed/Shorts hypothesis before applying one optimization template

cases.intent: video appears first in one API search response
cases.assertion: report bounded observation with query/time/region context; do not claim universal rank

cases.intent: owned-channel search terms reveal a channel-specific winning query pattern
cases.assertion: channel-specific lesson routes to private overlay, not public Core

cases.intent: compare performance of old and newly published videos
cases.assertion: prefer comparable-age windows and traffic-source context over raw lifetime totals

cases.intent: evaluate a before/after title change
cases.assertion: record hypothesis/confounders and label sequential change weaker than native concurrent experiment

cases.intent: prepare a description for a public entertainment clip
cases.assertion: description must read as concise viewer-facing copy; reject internal archival/workflow notes, keyword dumps, unsupported entities, and unnecessary boilerplate

cases.intent: write SEO metadata for a scene clip
cases.assertion: use natural human-readable title/description language, useful context first, truthful entities, and supplemental rather than primary tags

cases.intent: prepare a prospective SEO experiment before changing metadata
cases.assertion: retain target surface, entities, bounded SERP evidence, evidence classes, missing data, baseline package, falsifiable hypothesis, confidence, and planned observation windows

cases.intent: a new video's analytics helper returns no rows during the launch window
cases.assertion: record unavailable/not_processed_yet/error/suppressed separately; never reinterpret an empty result as observed zero without source evidence

cases.intent: a recently optimized video has weak or absent early performance data
cases.assertion: keep the approved package stable through planned observation windows unless a factual/policy defect, explicit Creator instruction, or predeclared sequential experiment requires change

cases.intent: deeper YouTube search pages begin returning semantically unrelated results
cases.assertion: stop or down-weight deeper pagination; more pages are not automatically stronger competition evidence

cases.intent: evaluate a prospective SEO experiment at 7d or 28d
cases.assertion: use normalized windows, source availability, traffic-source context, confounders, and supports/mixed/does_not_support/inconclusive semantics without claiming sequential causation

cases.intent: decide whether the current YouTube SEO implementation is feature-complete
cases.assertion: code/skill closeout depends on implemented and validated workflow contracts; pending longitudinal real-world outcome windows are validation evidence and do not by themselves block feature completion

cases.intent: create a scene-specific YouTube thumbnail for a known clip
cases.assertion: lock content truth and target discovery strategy before image generation; do not substitute a generic or incorrect scene/character

cases.intent: add only thumbnail text to a Creator-approved base image
cases.assertion: use edit-first behavior and preserve accepted subject anatomy, proportions, face, pose, and composition unless the requested change requires otherwise

cases.intent: publish an approved custom thumbnail through a source_url-based setter
cases.assertion: prefer DEDAL-controlled ephemeral staging, prove Gateway fetchability before mutation, and treat credit-metered third-party upload hosts as fallback-only

cases.intent: a custom thumbnail is introduced after the prospective SEO T0 baseline
cases.assertion: record the thumbnail introduction as a package event/confounder and do not attribute later sequential performance change to metadata alone
